responsibility: Declares the context abstraction for GCC’s diagnostic output-spec DSL. It provides diagnostics_output_spec::context, which supplies error reporting, base-filename lookup, affected line-map access, output-file opening, and the parse_and_make_sink entry point, plus gcc_spec_context, the compiler-side implementation that reports option errors through diagnostic_context at a controlling source location. This header is the integration API between generic output-spec parsing and GCC/libgdiagnostics callers.
same_name_distinction: Defines the public context layer for the output-spec subsystem—especially diagnostics_output_spec::context and gcc_spec_context, through which callers provide error reporting, location maps, base filenames, and file opening. Unlike gcc/diagnostic-output-spec.cc, it does not implement parsing or scheme dispatch; it declares the integration API those implementations depend on.
